meta.description: Clone isolado: consulta a previa da fila e valida envio WAHA para destinos de teste.

nodes.name: Schedule Recorrente Fanout Teste
nodes.notes: Executa a validacao recorrente do fan-out sem claimar a fila.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { profile: 'feminino', marketplace: 'shopee', limit: 1, run_id: `test-fanout-${Date.now()}`, source_flow: 'recorrente_supabase' } }];

nodes.name: Set Contexto Schedule Grupo
nodes.notes: Contexto fixo do schedule automatico para envio real ao grupo allowlisted.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { profile: 'feminino', marketplace: 'shopee', limit: 1, run_id: `test-fanout-manual-${Date.now()}`, source_flow: 'recorrente_supabase' } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ session: 'default', chatId: $json.waha_chat_id, file: { mimetype: 'image/jpeg', url: $json.waha_image_url, filename: $json.waha_image_filename || 'oferta.jpg' }, caption: $json.message_text }) }}

nodes.name: Schedule Mensagens Estaticas
nodes.notes: Horarios diarios das mensagens estaticas. Ajuste somente as regras deste trigger.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ session: 'default', chatId: $json.target_chat_id, file: { mimetype: 'image/jpeg', data: $json.waha_image_base64, filename: $json.waha_image_filename || 'image.jpg' }, caption: $json.message_text }) }}
